meta.title: 2026-2027 Event Trip Planners — Free, for Groups
meta.description: Plan your 2026-2027 event trip with WePlanify. Dedicated free planners for the FIFA World Cup, Oktoberfest, Europe's Christmas markets, the 2027 total solar eclipse, the Rugby World Cup and more — built for groups of fans who travel together.

hero.title:

event trip — together
hero.description: Eleven dedicated planners for the biggest events of the next two years. Pick yours, build a shared itinerary, split costs and coordinate the squad — all free.

intro.title: One planner per event, built for groups
intro.body: Big events bring big logistics: matches across host cities, festival passes for a 12-person crew, camping permits, last-minute date clashes. Each of our 2026-2027 event pages is built for that specific event — host-city tables, real schedules, the gotchas only fans hit. Pick yours below.

cta.title: Not heading to one of these? Plan your own group trip.
cta.description: WePlanify works for any group trip — bachelorette, birthday, family, road trip, anything else. Same shared kitty, itinerary, polls and packing list.

events.title: Total Solar Eclipse — Aug 12, 2026
events.description: The once-a-decade trip to totality. Best viewing spots, weather contingencies, accommodation that gets booked out 18 months ahead.

events.title: Oktoberfest 2026
events.description: 16 days, 191st edition, free entry — but the tents reserve in tables of 10, so the group has to lock it in early. Munich hotels spike for the run, and someone always fronts the Maß round.

events.title: Christmas Markets 2026
events.description: Vienna, Colmar, Nuremberg, Cologne, Prague, Brussels — each city runs its own dates, so picking the weekend picks the destination. Hotels sell out by September, so settle the vote early.

events.title: Ski Season 2026-27
events.description: Tignes and Val Thorens open Nov 21 and close May 2. One person fronts the chalet while lift passes, rental and food split unevenly — and the February school-holiday weeks cost more.

events.title: Total Solar Eclipse — Aug 2, 2027
events.description: 6 min 22 s of totality over Luxor — the longest on accessible land this century. Twelve months to choose between a Nile cruise and a land base, and the scarce resource is group agreement, not beds.

events.title: Rugby World Cup 2027
events.description: The first 24-team edition, pools already drawn. Long-haul fares book about 12 months out and the next ticket sale is Oct 1, 2026, first come first served — so settle the multi-city route before the Round-of-16 bracket even exists.

events.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
events.description: 16 host cities across three countries. Plan your multi-city route, split costs by category, and coordinate the fan group across borders.

events.title: Tomorrowland 2026
events.description: DreamVille tickets, festival passes, train logistics. Coordinate the squad and the shared kitty so nobody chases anyone for €40 the week after.

events.title: Ultra Europe 2026
events.description: Three days on the Adriatic. Hotel vs Airbnb, festival pass logistics, and side trips around Dalmatia — for the squad that wants more than just the main stage.

events.title: Hellfest 2026
events.description: Four days of metal in Clisson. Camping logistics, carpool, and the lineup-to-stage spreadsheet — all in one shared plan.

events.title: Champions League Final 2026
events.description: The biggest club final of the year at the Puskás Aréna. Plan transport, hotel and pre-match meetup for the squad.
